author: Mark Atwood
text: Recommendation ratified after no pushback in ~41 hours: option (A) — keep Sha256(String) inner repr. The recommendation argued: (1) only current consumer reads the value as &str (BlobUploadResponse.sha256 → as_str at blob.rs:631); (2) variable-time PartialEq concern addressed by docs-only fix per .24 (closed); (3) heap-alloc cost (32 vs 64 bytes) unmeasurable vs blob body size. Status quo stands. Closing without code change.
